references.text: Here we find the story of the shepherds in the fields to whom the angels appear, and who then go to see Jesus in Bethlehem, which directly relates to the event described in Luke 2:15.

This passage in Isaiah prophesies about nations streaming to your light and kings to your dawning brightness, which can be seen as a prediction of events like that in Luke 2:15, where the shepherds represent the first of many who come to honor Jesus.
The story of the wise men from the East following a star to find and worship the baby Jesus parallels the shepherds' journey to see Jesus in Luke 2:15.
